settings.title: Can I upgrade from a Hearth to a full FireLight® Sauna later on?
settings.content:
Yes! Many customers start with a Glow or Hearth and later upgrade to FireLight® Sauna for the full experience.

If you already have a Hearth, then you only need the Sauna Enclosure and Sauna Stool to complete your FireLight® Sauna.

settings.title: What is the SilverLining® upgrade, and is it worth it?
settings.content: The SilverLining™ upgrades the FireLight Sauna by adding a layer of our custom-made SilverLining™ fabric, which blocks 99.99% of ambient RF radiation (such as cellular, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth signals). It’s the choice for those seeking the ultimate wellness sanctuary. Learn more about how our SilverLining works.

settings.title: What makes the FireLight® Sauna different from using a Hearth alone?
settings.content:
Many of our customers love having the Hearth on our Pedestal in the living room, giving a cozy FireLight® glow just like a campfire, but without the smoke and the mess. It provides clean, flicker-free, blue-light-free light all day long and after sunset.

And for sure, the Hearth delivers powerful light therapy on its own; it’s used on its own for targeted therapy but using it inside the FireLight® Sauna takes your healing experience to a whole new level.

For full-body detox, stress relief, and the deepest healing experience, the FireLight® Sauna is the cornerstone of daily rejuvenation—many of our customers use it 3–6 days per week.

The FireLight® Sauna is designed for full-body cellular rejuvenation and deep detoxification. When inside our Sauna Enclosure,, your body rapidly reaches a profuse, passive sweat at a gentle ambient air temperature of 100–120°F (38–49°C).

By using the Hearth alone, you’ll still receive photobiomodulation (light therapy)—the deep, light-based cellular activation—and also a mild detox from the heat, but you won’t get the same level of sweat-induced detox, which requires an enclosed, heat-retentive space.

For the most effective, clinically researched benefits of sauna therapy, you must sweat at least 1 lb of water and raise your core temperature by 2-3°F. The sweating response is essential for the most profound, full-body detoxification. The skin becomes a powerful toxin elimination pathway only in the sauna with profuse sweating.

And the FireLight® Sauna’s enclosure levels up your healing experience in additional key ways:

  • Our Sauna Enclosure is all-organic, portable and easy to set-up and move around. It’s a fully-enclosed experience, so your whole body benefits and your mind gets a break from the chaotic world around you.
  • The Bamboo Grounding Mat provides earthing therapy and shields you from your home’ss wired electric fields (EF).
  • And if you choose the FireLight® Sauna with SilverLining™, you get 99.999% protection from wireless EMF (like 5G, WiFi, Bluetooth), creating a truly meditative, EMF-free healing environment—something no open-air setup can offer.
